moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio 3d-depth, written here): Cards placed along z (recipe 250 apart) and the camera moves forward z 0 -> 1000 over 4000 ms linear (perspective). Demo: 8 cards 60 x 40 at 60 z spacing (focal 360 on a 320 frame), camera 100 z / s, wrapping every 480 z; x alternates +-60 px, y -30 / 0 / +30; cards fade in far away and out just before the lens. Params: spacing (250) · travel (1000) · duration (4 s). Each card is projected by focal / depth; x alternates ±, y cycles −1 / 0 / +1, so cards grow and slide past both sides.
